description: Does each role do its real step as designed? A role runs a real brief on a fixture repo (a ticket, a correction, a review, a qc run, a lane's parent issue or publish); the case passes when its transcript shows each listed skill loaded before the step it serves, that step reached in the run, and where the case needs a verdict, the role's final message carrying it (facts and what each reads: .agents/skills/eval-cases/references/schema.md, Facts). Cases from #107's role probes and the owed evals that a transcript can decide.
